description: Works with business (working) days. mode "add": returns the date N business days after start_date (start_date itself is not counted; negative N goes backward; 0 returns start_date, or the next business day if start_date is not one). mode "count": counts business days from start_date to end_date, including both ends. Weekends default to Saturday and Sunday. Public holidays are NOT built in — pass them in "holidays".

holidays.description: Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to treat as non-working days

weekend.description: Weekend days as ISO weekday numbers (1=Monday ... 7=Sunday). Default [6, 7]. Example for Friday-Saturday weekends: [5, 6]

name: business_days
title: Business day calculator
